Title: Connect Phantom wallet on devnet
How to test: Open mexicoweb-dev.up.railway.app, click "Connect Wallet", select Phantom, approve connection
Expected Result: Wallet connects successfully, address and SOL balance are shown in the header

Title: Switch Phantom network to Devnet
How to test: In Phantom settings, switch active network to Devnet, reload the app
Expected Result: App detects Devnet and loads pool/position data without errors

Title: Fund wallet with devnet SOL
How to test: Use faucet.solana.com (or `solana airdrop`) to send devnet SOL to the connected wallet
Expected Result: Wallet balance increases by the requested SOL amount within a few seconds

Title: Obtain devnet MEX tokens
How to test: Request a transfer from the team dev-wallet (or run the provided mint script) to the test wallet
Expected Result: Test wallet receives the requested amount of MEX on devnet

Title: Add MEX token to Phantom
How to test: In Phantom token list enable the hidden-token toggle for MEX, or add manually by mint address
Expected Result: MEX balance and logo/ticker are visible in Phantom's asset list

Title: Verify pool stats on Stake page load
How to test: Open the Stake page with a wallet connected
Expected Result: Global cap, currently staked amount, pool occupancy indicator and APR range are displayed and internally consistent (occupied <= cap)

Title: Create first staking position at minimum amount
How to test: Enter the minimum allowed stake amount and minimum lock tier, submit the stake transaction, approve in Phantom
Expected Result: Transaction confirms, a new position appears in "My Positions" with correct amount and lock end date

Title: Verify ATA/position account creation on first stake
How to test: After the first stake, inspect the transaction on a devnet explorer
Expected Result: Instruction creates the position PDA and (if needed) the associated token account for MEX
column4: rent is paid from the staker's wallet

Title: Verify position details match input
How to test: Open the new position card in the UI
Expected Result: Displayed staked amount, lock duration and start date match what was submitted

Title: Perform Day 1 daily check-in
How to test: On the position, click "Check-in" for the first time
Expected Result: Check-in succeeds, streak counter shows 1, and the current rate reflects the primary-tier starting value

Title: Verify check-in cannot be repeated same day
How to test: Click "Check-in" again immediately after a successful check-in
Expected Result: Action is blocked (button disabled or on-chain rejection) with a clear "already checked in today" message

Title: Attempt to unstake before lock period ends
How to test: On a position still inside its lock window, click "Unstake"
Expected Result: Action is blocked by the UI and/or rejected on-chain

Title: Claim rewards while position is still locked
How to test: If claim is allowed mid-lock, click "Claim" on the locked position
Expected Result: Claimed amount matches the rewards accrued so far according to the displayed rate/formula

Title: Verify claim history entry is recorded
How to test: After claiming, open transaction/claim history
Expected Result: A new entry with the correct amount and timestamp appears in the history list

Title: Compound rewards into the existing position
How to test: Click "Compound" on a position with pending rewards
Expected Result: Position's staked amount increases by the compounded reward amount

Title: Verify pool occupancy indicator updates after stake/compound
How to test: Reload the Stake page after compounding
Expected Result: Pool occupancy percentage reflects the new total staked amount

Title: Wait for the minimum lock period to elapse
How to test: Using the minimum lock tier, wait (or fast-forward on a local validator) until the lock end timestamp passes
Expected Result: Position status changes from "Locked" to "Unlocked"/"Claimable" in the UI

Title: Verify unlocked position allows unstake
How to test: Open a position after its lock has elapsed and click "Unstake"
Expected Result: Unstake transaction is accepted and no longer blocked by the lock check

Title: Unstake the full position after unlock
How to test: Submit a full unstake for the unlocked position, approve in Phantom
Expected Result: Transaction confirms
column4: principal (and any un-claimed rewards per the design) is returned to the wallet

Title: Verify auto-compound-at-unlock behavior
How to test: Let pending rewards accumulate on a position, then let it reach unlock without manually compounding
Expected Result: At unlock, rewards are automatically compounded/settled per design before/at the unstake step, matching the documented behavior

Title: Verify position is closed/removed after full unstake
How to test: After a successful full unstake, refresh "My Positions"
Expected Result: The position no longer appears in the active positions list (or is marked closed) and its account is closed on-chain

Title: Verify final wallet balance reconciles
How to test: Compare pre-stake and post-unstake MEX balances against principal + net rewards
Expected Result: Final balance equals principal plus all claimed/compounded rewards minus nothing unaccounted for (no unexplained loss)

Title: Create a second independent position while the first exists
How to test: With one active/closed position already present, create another stake with different amount/tier
Expected Result: Both positions are tracked independently with their own lock timers and balances

Title: Verify no artificial limit on number of positions per wallet
How to test: Create three or more simultaneous positions from the same wallet
Expected Result: All positions are created successfully with no "max positions" error, consistent with "independent positions without a count limit"

Title: Verify indexer/API reflects final on-chain state
How to test: Query the read-only API for the test wallet after the smoke run completes
Expected Result: API response matches on-chain state (positions, balances, streaks) with no stale or missing data
